en: Black-and-white postcard view of a harbor scene with several boats. In the foreground is a small sailboat moored at a wooden pier with people on board, and another rowboat at the lower right. In the background is a large passenger steamship labeled "EXPRESS I" on the bow and on a sign near the upper deck, with a smokestack and several lifeboats. The setting appears to be a coastal or archipelago harbor with low land on the horizon and scattered sailboats. Printed text in Swedish is visible on the image.
